attributes.content: Receptive Language — ID Common Objects: Presented 5 objects (cup, shoe, ball, book, spoon) and asked Jamie to point to each. She got 4 out of 5 correct on the first try — hesitated on "spoon" but self-corrected after a brief pause. Great focus and eye contact throughout.
attributes.reasoning: Jamie correctly identified 4 out of 5 objects during the receptive language task, demonstrating good focus and eye contact.
attributes.matchedBlock: Receptive Language: Present 5 common objects (e.g., cup, shoe, ball, book, spoon) and ask Jamie to identify each by pointing. Use ABLLS-R C8 materials.
